taste:
This pizza is built around the contrast between salty cured ham and sweet, acidic pineapple. Thick ham slices give the savoury topping substance, while juicy fruit brings a noticeably different texture. Rich tomato sauce sits underneath, with melting mozzarella adding creaminess rather than another sharp flavour. If you enjoy fruit alongside savoury ingredients, that contrast is the main reason to choose it.

The thin, crispy base provides a firmer bite against the softer cheese and juicy topping. Served hot from the oven, the pizza brings those textures together without losing the distinction between ham and pineapple. Expect sweetness to be part of the meal, not merely a background note.
